title: Synthetic System
author: Such--Balance
selftext:
Synthetic System

Playable Link: [https://twosecondgames.itch.io/synthetic-system](https://twosecondgames.itch.io/synthetic-system)

Short trailer: [https://youtu.be/qYNflzp7WgkSimple](https://youtu.be/qYNflzp7WgkSimple) 

Still a very bare-bone tower defense game with a twist. You play as an alien high-tech slime mold and growing is your first and only priority.

Towards choke-points, resources or just because you want to overtake the map. Towers can only be build on territory so grow fast before the enemy outnumbers you.

Its free to play and my aim is to vastly expand this game into an actual fully fleshed out game (eventually).

Looking for people to enjoy this new type of tower defense game, and comments on balance, mainly considering the growth and feel of the territory and whatever else springs to mind to improve this concept.

Any tips on using ai to improve more than welcome.

Obviously with some of the stuff i see on here made with ai this kinda pales in comparison in both scale and graphics. Im a beginner and my main aim at the moment is to get better and really try to get the feel of the territory, what it means to have and protect it, the looks of it and how it enables in depth game play, to work all those things out into something new.
